setParents.reason: Birth date/place and marriage from Luzerne marriage docket No. 11054 (image read); named as William's mother 'Anna … Higgins' on 1926 application; census 1910/1920/1940. Death 1951 probable (FS tree from Find a Grave index). Parents speculative (FS, unsourced).

Named as Frank's father (laborer, Plymouth, b. Penna.) on the 1923 licence (confirmed name); dates and parentage from FS tree GZQN-SCM with a 1927 PA death certificate attached; identity with the 1870 Danville household's 'James 9' probable.
1820 marriage (original read, L 10 Nr. 1590), named as father in Friedrich's 1835 birth and 1862 marriage entries; three Freiburg-archdiocese index entries.
Named in the 1820 marriage, 1835 birth and 1862 marriage entries (originals read).
Baptism (Gortnahoe 10 Sep 1808) and marriage (3 Feb 1833) as read by Dwyer from the parish registers; son Andrew's 1842 baptism names him. The tree's 'Thomas Heffernan 1791' is a different man.

Baptism 28 Feb 1814 (Gortnahoe) and marriage as cited by Dwyer; 1904 Luzerne death register (age 90, b. Ireland, parents 'Thos & Ann Boney') independently confirms her father; son Andrew's baptism names her.

Harvey Book pp.134-135 states Samuel Pringle married Martha, eldest daughter of Thomas and Keturah Lamoreux, in 1790; Thomas's will names 'Martha Pringle'; Harvey Book pp.370-371 makes James his son. His own parentage is only possible.

Andreas Grub's son Frederick is confirmed (1783 confirmation, 1791 will, mother's 1810 will); his identity with the Luzerne Frederick Croup who married Mary Young (Harvey Book) is probable-to-confirmed; WikiTree's child table gives Frederick's wife as Maria Jung and death 1841.
SAR Patriot P-232580; Ruttenber's 1776 militia list ('Thos. Lammoreux, ensign'); his 1815/1826 will names wife Keturah and daughter Martha Pringle. His parentage is probable.
Jettenbach baptism and marriage (WikiTree Grub-4, FamilySearch QPKL-RZNB), will of 1791 (Northampton file #1430) naming son Frederick, burial at St. John's Easton. Birth date conflicts.

SAR approved a 2017 supplemental application tracing patriot John Lamoreaux (1723-1809) to Thomas; 1752 deed to 'Charity Lamoree, wife of John Lamoree'. Caveat: the 1919 Lamoureux Record leaves Thomas in either John's or Peter's family; John's 1809 will not seen.
Ulmet baptism and parents via WikiTree/FamilySearch (probable); burial and Tohickon baptism of a daughter confirmed; his fatherhood of John's Anna Maria is unproven.

Alva M. Tuttle, Tuttle-Tuthill Lines in America (1968) p. 311 makes him son of James Tuthill (b. 1692) and husband of Temperance Smith; strengthened in Round 3 by the 1756 will of James Tuthill Jr. naming 'my father, James Tuthill … of Orange County' and by Browne executors in two Tuthill branches. No record yet names John (c.1730) as James's son; Akerly (1898) does not list a John among James's children. His being Keturah's father rests on Alva Tuttle, the SAR application (Woodbury Clove 1755) and the naming pattern.

His own parentage ('James Smith (Job, Richard)') and marriage to Jerusha Topping are stated by F. K. Smith (1967) and Pelletreau (1898 App. p. 479); B. F. Thompson lists James among Elizabeth Thompson's sons. Probable as John's ancestor because Temperance's parentage is probable.

Elnathan Topping's will (15 Sep 1751) gives 5s each to 'my daughters, Phebe, Mary, and Jerusha'; F. K. Smith (1967) says James married 'Jerusha, daughter of Elnathan and Mary Topping'. Tree's parents (Josiah Topping & Hannah Sayre) are wrong: Banks (1901) gives that couple only sons Josiah and John.

B. F. Thompson's History of Long Island (vol. 3 p. 295) says John Thompson left 'a daughter Elizabeth, who married Job Smith of Smithtown' and lists her sons, James among them; F. K. Smith agrees; Jacobus treats her as a 'highly probable' child of John (who died intestate). Her mother is now Mary (surname unknown), not Hannah Brewster.
Identified as Bull Smith's wife by Edward Smith (NYGBR 121): William Hammond's 1662 will names 'daughter Sarah Smith with her son Adam'; 1640 Phillips–Winthrop letter. 'Probable, strong.'

Baptism and marriage from FamilySearch index / Dunstable register (probable); Howell (1887) and F. K. Smith make him Capt. Elnathan's father. As John's ancestor he is now 13 generations up (one more than reported in the uploads) and depends on Temperance's parentage.
Probable baptism at Langley Marish c. Jul 1611 (Bucks Bishop's Transcripts; Gyll 1862; WikiTree Aldridge-218).
Baptism (FreeREG Tharston register), 1637 passenger list and Hingham records confirmed (Round 3). As John's ancestor, depends on the probable James→John link.
Named in husband's will (confirmed); baptism at Long Stratton per WikiTree (probable).

Named as Sharon M. Petriello's father in the Ancestry tree; his marriage to Mary Cognetti is confirmed by Leo S. Cognetti's 2019 obituary (sister "Mary Petriello (John)"), and the 2024 obituary of John T. Petriello Jr. names the parents John and Mary Petriello and sibling "Sharon Meier (Thomas)". Parentage (James + Mollie) rests on the tree plus the Round 1/2 analysis that 'Mollie' is James's wife.

Leo S. Cognetti's 2019 obituary lists sister "Mary Petriello (John)"; the 2016 Thanksgiving article names Mary Petriello as one of two surviving siblings of Joseph F. Cognetti; 1950 census lists Mary (17) at home with Frank and Helen Cognetti.
His own birth and parents are confirmed (Dasà Nati 1855 act 18, image read). His link as Frank Cognetti's father is probable (tree only; Frank's birthplace and date not found).
Death act Morti 1901 act 28 and son's birth act Nati 1869 act 110 (both Antenati images read).
Death act Morti 1916 act 22 (image read) names her parents Gaetano and Caterina Di Leo and husband Pietro Petriello; son's 1869 birth act names her 'Grazia di Marino di Gaetano'.
Death act San Mango Morti 1860 act 30 and son Domenico's 1840 birth act (both images read).
